_readme: Testimonials appear on the site ONLY for entries where "placeholder" is false. While every entry is a placeholder the whole section is hidden, so nothing fake can ship.
How to get real ones: ask colleagues on LinkedIn (Profile > Add profile section > Recommendations > Ask for a recommendation), or ask by email for 2-3 sentences.

ALWAYS get explicit written permission (an email or message saying 'yes, you may publish this with my name and role') before adding a quote here. Do not edit quotes beyond trimming; keep the author's meaning.

Fields: quote, name, role, company, relationship ('manager' | 'peer' | 'report'), linkedin (optional URL), avatar (optional path under public/), placeholder (set to false when the entry is real and approved).
